To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we present a framework for motion planning in traffic scenes, which can be used for autonomous driving applications as well as driver assistant systems, that we present an approach to predict the future motion of traffic participants in a traffic scene, that we consider the interaction of traffic participants in this prediction, that we present a safety assessment of a predicted trajectory, and that we show the functionality of our approach by simulation scenarios as well as real-world experiments.
we present an approach to motion prediction of traffic participants in a scene, which is based on an optimization problem and which is able to predict the future motion of a traffic scene.

a) a novel framework for motion prediction is proposed, b) the interaction of traffic participants is explicitly considered, c) a safety evaluation of the predicted trajectories is realized, and d) the framework is suitable for driver assistant and autonomous driving systems.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the prediction of the motion and the safety assessment of traffic participants.
motion prediction and the evaluation of the safety of future traffic scenes for automotive applications.
the development of a motion prediction approach, which considers the mutual influence of the traffic participants.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the developed framework is capable to perform an efficient and reliable prediction of the motion of traffic participants in real traffic scenes, considering their mutual influence.

the developed framework is capable of predicting the motion of traffic participants in complex traffic scenes, considering the interaction of traffic participants, and assessing the safety of traffic scenes.

the proposed method can predict future traffic scenes and assess the safety of these scenes, based on a prediction of the motion of the traffic participants, taking the mutual influence of them into account.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed framework can be used as the basis for the development of a driver assistant system and autonomous driving applications.
we developed a framework for motion and scene prediction for automotive purposes.
the proposed method is a novel approach for motion prediction of traffic participants.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the prediction of motion of the traffic participants can be achieved by considering the mutual influence of them, and the safety evaluation of the traffic scene can be realized by the collision probability of the vehicle performing a certain trajectory.
we provide a novel approach to the problem of interactive motion prediction and safety assessment for traffic scenes.
the developed framework is capable of predicting future trajectories of the vehicles and the safety assessment of the traffic scenes in real-world scenarios.
